user_story: As a user, I want deleting a non-existent task to return a clear error so that I know the operation failed.

positive.title: Delete existing task successfully
steps: Log in as a user with appropriate permissions.
positive.expected_result: The task is successfully deleted and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to delete a non-existent task
steps: Log in as a user with appropriate permissions.
Attempt to delete a task that does not exist by using its ID.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the task does not exist.

edge.title: Delete a task with an empty or invalid ID
steps: Log in as a user with appropriate permissions.
Navigate to the delete task interface.
Attempt to input an empty value or a clearly malformed ID for deletion.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the task ID is invalid or not provided.
